text: ok cool now for the mesh editor, is it possible to be able to cross copy/import one into another. so i can make one piece and pull it into another
resolution: Added cross-model part import to the Studio mesh editor. The parts library was already cross-model (each saved model carries its parts inline) but there was no UI to pull one model's part into another — you could only add fresh shapes or import an external GLB into a NEW model. Now the outliner header has a '⤓ part' chip opening ImportPartDialog: it lists every OTHER library model and its parts, and clicking a part drops a deep-cloned copy into the currently-open model via the existing addPart (fresh id/tint/lift), staying open so you can pull several. Geometry + UV + mounts + pivot transfer; the model-level PIXEL paint texture does not (it is packed per-model), noted in the dialog. New editMesh.cloneMesh does the deep copy with no shared refs (verts/faces/uv/flags/mounts/pivot/slots) so the import is independently editable, never a live alias of its source; LayerStrip gained an optional onImport chip (paint editor unaffected), Outliner passes it through, StudioEditor renders the dialog. editMesh 97/97 (added a clone deep-copy test), StudioViewport bundles clean; hot-reload TSX, no store schema change.
